name: COMP_040
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (87%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set and a reliable input support the call [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 87%, InSitu 11% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Invasive only | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 88th percentile | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Invasive | Mostly agree [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 5, 9) · ↑ invasive · Concept model links stromal infiltration to invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 8) · ↑ invasive · Also associated with invasive in the concept model · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 8) · ↑ invasive · Score above typical, but spot check 0/20 [F4] · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 4, 7, 10) · context · Descriptive only; spot check 8/20 [F3] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses is Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- The mitosis score is Unreliable and the lymphocyte score is Weak; neither should support the call.
- Nearest InSitu neighbor (BACH_0155) differs mainly in duct-confined and stromal-invasion scores.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 5, 9**: confirm true stromal invasion, not in situ growth.
2. **Regions 0, 1, 8**: count mitoses and grade pleomorphism directly.
3. **Region 6**: look for duct-confined atypia, the in situ alternative (11%).
